title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 3–5 and 11–13; kit.jsx Frame described; insulin.jsx table
findings.title: Step descriptions omit the displayed duration values
findings.problem: During playback, Frame replaces the full SVG description with the caption. The SVG has role="img", so its table cells are not independently accessible. Rapid, regular and NPH captions and narration omit duration, although the displayed table teaches 3–5, 5–8 and 12–18 hours. Screen-reader users lose a central part of the highlighted row.
findings.fix: Provide an accessible HTML table, or include the complete highlighted row—onset, peak and duration—in each step's accessible description.

findings.where: Step worked with type="rapid" or type="short"; peak-band leader and dose annotation. These variants are not pictured in images 8 and 16.
findings.title: Peak leaders run through the dose label
findings.problem: The vertical leader crosses the dose annotation row at y=134. For rapid insulin it sits at x≈58.9; for regular insulin, x≈77.8. The dose text starts at x=56, so both leaders pass through the word "dose". The pictured NPH variant avoids this collision.
findings.fix: Route the leader around the dose annotation or reserve separate horizontal space for it. Render-test the worked layout for all four supported insulin types.

assessment: Needs revision: step views hide duration data from screen readers, and rapid/regular worked examples have overlapping annotations.
